indexes.name: market_delivery_outbox_pkey

indexes.name: market_delivery_outbox_tokens_idx

triggers.name: camp_trades_delivery_outbox_trigger
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER camp_trades_delivery_outbox_trigger AFTER INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON indexer_v2.camp_trades FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION indexer_v2.track_market_delivery()

functions.name: mark_market_delivery
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION indexer_v2.mark_market_delivery(p_chain bigint, p_event text, p_token text, p_reset boolean)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
AS $function$
  INSERT INTO indexer_v2.market_delivery_outbox (chain_id, event_id, tokens, needs_reset)
  VALUES (p_chain, p_event, ARRAY[p_token], p_reset)
  ON CONFLICT (chain_id, event_id) DO UPDATE SET
    version = gen_random_uuid(),
    needs_reset = indexer_v2.market_delivery_outbox.needs_reset OR EXCLUDED.needs_reset,
    tokens = ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT token FROM unnest(indexer_v2.market_delivery_outbox.tokens || EXCLUDED.tokens) token ORDER BY token)
$function$
